about: The literal table both estimates are checked against (pr-le-leave-early.md §0.3, AC-LE2-6): Rust mineworld_rule_controller::commute (commute_tests.rs) and Python mineworld_sdk.ways (sdk/python/tests/test_ways.py). strides = ceil(length_mm / 1340) + doors + 1; estimate_s = strides × stride_s; lead_s is rule's default policy (slack 500 per mille, margin 300 s, cap 7 200 s), checked by Rust only.
